baseline_workbook: data/Hungry F&B Database.Public Access 2026-10-17 Verified Menu Catalogue Refresh 40.xlsx
scope: Read-only quality profiling of directory, menu, image, and coverage sheets. Sample identifiers are SFA licence IDs and worksheet row numbers; no phone numbers, emails, or full contact values are retained.
method: Counted actual workbook cells. Exact duplicate menu rows and obvious format anomalies are deterministic candidates. HTTP URLs, old menu facts, contact-format outliers, and unreviewed images are flagged for source verification only; none are asserted false without evidence.

prioritized_findings.finding: Two exact full-row duplicates exist in Menu Items. Each pair is byte-for-byte equal across all columns and can be reduced to one row after confirming no table-level row references depend on the duplicate.

proposed_rows_to_remove_one_copy.action: Retain one exact row; remove the duplicate copy only.
Retain one exact row; remove the duplicate copy only.

prioritized_findings.caveat: Do not collapse the other 172 repeated licence-brand-item keys automatically; they are not exact full-row duplicates and may encode scope or variants.

prioritized_findings.finding: One opening-hours value contains a doubled colon in the time expression.
prioritized_findings.action: Check the current operator listing and replace only with exact current hours; do not infer a correction from the malformed text.
prioritized_findings.confidence: high that formatting is malformed; replacement value unverified

prioritized_findings.finding: 7,871 menu rows carry the explicit “Historical reference; source data is dated July 2026 or unknown and was not rechecked” status; these cover 1,660 brand labels and 2,612 nonblank outlet/licence scopes. Another 4,679 menu rows have no source URL.
prioritized_findings.action: Refresh in bounded brand/operator batches from current first-party menus and preserve outlet or brand scope; keep historical rows marked until exact current evidence is found.

prioritized_findings.finding: 22 contact fields contain email addresses; 9 other contact fields have 13–20 digits after punctuation removal. These are anomaly candidates, not confirmed false values; some are explicitly labeled as brand-level email, while long digit sequences may contain multiple numbers or extensions.
prioritized_findings.action: Compare with exact operator outlet pages; retain verified shared brand contacts with clear scope labels and remove only values disproved by source evidence.

prioritized_findings.finding: 688 directory website cells use http:// across 482 unique URLs; 70 website cells point to social-profile/link-in-bio domains; two use the sitebuilder host sitelift.site. These patterns do not by themselves prove a URL is false.
prioritized_findings.action: Check redirects and official operator ownership in batches; promote HTTPS only after a verified redirect/current site match, and label social profiles as such if retained.

prioritized_findings.finding: Six exact image URLs appear more than once; five duplicates pair a brand-level Yoshinoya candidate with an outlet-associated candidate, while one exact image URL is shared across two distinct outlet licences. 2,043 of 2,499 candidates are not visually checked. These are review/association issues, not automatic deletions.
prioritized_findings.action: Deduplicate exact URL associations only after preserving all valid outlet joins; prioritize image visual review before any Approved Image URL promotion.

prioritized_findings.finding: 2,544 records lack coordinate pairs. Existing coordinate pairs all fall inside the broad Singapore bounding box and postal-code text agrees with six-digit postal values when present. 38,267 rows remain labeled candidate-based public access; 12 are verified from operator sources.
prioritized_findings.action: Continue exact-postal open-data geocoding for missing pairs and direct facility/operator checks for public-access claims; do not promote building-level coordinates to stall precision.

limitations: A format anomaly is not proof that contact, URL, menu, or hours are false.
HTTP availability, live status, redirect behavior, and ownership were not tested in this profiling pass.
The broad coordinate bounds and address-text check are internal consistency checks, not external geospatial verification.
